title: Lys's final line on leaving the party ('You had your chance to get him clear, and Thornwold burned with him still inside it') reads as if her brother Cal was still in Thornwold when I burned the Gallows Glade, but I had already freed Cal and sent him home turns earlier ('Quest done: Cal's Reckoning' / 'He is really coming home'). The pronoun 'him' is ambiguous/misleading right after a scene about her actual brother.
where: The Burned Glade / talk to Lys after burning The Gallows Glade
